description_en: Prefetches content from the origin server to L2 cache nodes so that first-time requests can directly hit the cache, reducing the load on the origin server
description_zh: 调用本接口将源站的内容主动预热到L2 Cache节点上，首次访问可直接命中缓存，缓解源站压力
name: PreloadVodObjectCaches

parameters.help_zh: 预热文件URL。多个URL使用换行符（\n或\r\n）分隔
parameters.name: object_path

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to prefetch content directly to L2 nodes. Valid values:

true: The prefetch node hierarchy must include L2 nodes.

false: Content is prefetched only to the origin-fetching layer nodes. This is the default value. The origin-fetching layer nodes can be L2 or L3 nodes
parameters.help_zh:
是否直接预热到L2节点。取值：

true：代表预热的节点层级必须包含L2节点。

false：代表仅预热回源层节点（false为默认值，回源层节点可能是L2节点，也可能是L3节点）
parameters.name: l2_preload

parameters.help_en: By default, prefetch requests carry the Accept-Encoding: gzip header. If you want prefetch requests to carry other headers or implement multi-replica prefetching, you can use this parameter to specify custom prefetch headers. Submit the headers in JSON format
parameters.help_zh: 预热请求默认携带的header是Accept-Encoding:gzip，如果您需要预热请求携带其他header，或者实现多副本预热，那么可以使用该参数来实现自定义预热header。用JSON串格式提交
parameters.name: with_header

PreloadTaskId.description_en: The ID of the prefetch task. Multiple task IDs are separated by commas (,)
PreloadTaskId.description_zh: 预热返回的任务ID。多个任务ID用半角逗号（,）分隔
